description:
The VIPCOO H3 Ultra is a 74V electric dirt bike built for experienced adult riders who want strong off-road performance, a removable high-capacity battery and a full-size mixed-wheel platform for suitable private land. It combines a 4,500W motor, three selectable speed modes, hydraulic brakes and dual suspension, with a manufacturer-stated top speed of up to 49.7 mph.

74V 4,500W motor for strong acceleration and climbing performance

74V 36Ah removable battery for flexible charging and extended riding

Three riding modes with maximum speeds of approximately 21.7, 34.8 and 49.7 mph

17-inch front and 14-inch rear off-road tyres for stability and obstacle clearance
Hydraulic front suspension and nitrogen-charged rear shock
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes

Headlight, rear light and indicators for improved visibility

Digital display and reverse function for clearer control and easier manoeuvring

What is the VIPCOO H3 Ultra?
The VIPCOO H3 Ultra is a high-performance electric dirt bike designed for recreational off-road riding on suitable private land. Its compact steel frame, wide padded seat and mixed-size wheel setup create a substantial yet controlled riding position, while the removable battery and modular structure support practical charging and maintenance.
How fast does the VIPCOO H3 Ultra go?
The H3 Ultra offers three selectable riding modes. Lower modes support more progressive control, while Mode 3 provides access to the bike's full manufacturer-stated performance.

Speed and range figures are manufacturer-stated maximums and are not guaranteed. Actual results vary with rider weight, riding style, terrain, gradients, tyre pressure, battery condition and temperature.
74V 36Ah removable battery
The 74V 36Ah battery provides the energy capacity required for the H3 Ultra's high-output motor. Its removable design allows the battery to be charged separately from the bike where appropriate and makes routine inspection more convenient.
Mixed-wheel off-road setup
A 17-inch front tyre helps the bike roll across ruts, stones and uneven ground. The 14-inch rear tyre supports responsive drive and keeps the rear of the bike compact. Together, the mixed-wheel layout balances obstacle clearance, traction and manoeuvrability.
Hydraulic front and nitrogen rear suspension
Hydraulic front suspension absorbs impacts through the handlebars, while the nitrogen-charged rear shock controls movement beneath the seat. This dual-suspension combination is designed to improve stability and comfort across rough off-road surfaces.
Hydraulic braking and rider information
Front and rear hydraulic disc brakes provide progressive braking from both wheels. The digital display shows speed in mph, battery level, selected riding mode and fault-code information.
An integrated headlight, rear light and indicators improve visibility. The built-in reverse function assists with low-speed manoeuvring in confined areas or when repositioning the bike.
Modular design for practical ownership
The H3 Ultra uses a compact modular layout intended to simplify assembly, inspection and component replacement. Its steel frame, wide padded seat and reinforced handlebar crossbar create a robust rider platform. The crossbar is not a substitute for certified protective equipment.

Frequently asked questions
What is the top speed of the VIPCOO H3 Ultra?
The manufacturer-stated maximum speed is up to 49.7 mph in Mode 3. Mode 1 is rated up to 21.7 mph and Mode 2 up to 34.8 mph.
What is the stated range?
The display-estimated maximum range is up to 68 miles in Mode 1, 40 miles in Mode 2 and 24 miles in Mode 3. Real-world range will normally vary.
Is the H3 Ultra battery removable?
Yes. The 74V 36Ah battery can be removed from the bike for appropriate separate charging, inspection or storage.
What wheel sizes does it use?
The H3 Ultra uses a 17-inch front wheel and a 14-inch rear wheel with off-road tyres.
What suspension does it have?
It combines hydraulic front suspension with a nitrogen-charged rear shock.
Is the VIPCOO H3 Ultra waterproof?
No. It is rated IPX4 for splash resistance. Do not submerge it, pressure-wash electrical components or ride through deep or flooded water.
Where can the H3 Ultra be ridden?
The H3 Ultra is designed for off-road use on suitable private land with the landowner's permission. Licensing, registration, insurance, equipment and public-road requirements vary by location. Check the rules that apply before riding.
Responsible riding notice
The VIPCOO H3 Ultra is a high-performance machine for experienced adult riders. Wear a certified full-face helmet and suitable eye, hand, body, knee and ankle protection. Inspect the bike before every ride, stay within your ability and do not disable or modify its safety systems. Maximum-speed riding should only take place in controlled conditions on suitable private land.
